name: Ferocitas the Dream Eater
summary: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar sends you after a stolen emerald in northern Teldrassil. The jewel was pried from his damaged heirloom dreamcatcher by Gnarlpine furbolgs north of Starbreeze Village, and now hangs from their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater.

sections.title: A Defiled Heirloom
sections.body: Tallonkai Swiftroot felt relief when the dreamcatcher recovered from the corrupted wilds came back to him, then dismay at its ruined state. The sacred artifact had been vandalized, its emerald centerpiece pried from the woven frame. Night elves spoke of Gnarlpine mystics north of Starbreeze Village, fallen under the influence of a furbolg leader named Ferocitas the Dream Eater. He wore a brilliant green stone around his neck. In Ferocitas's clutches, the sacred gem was useless and perverse, so Tallonkai sent defenders to take it back.

sections.title: Purging the Mystics
sections.body: The Gnarlpine furbolgs in Teldrassil's northern reaches were once peaceful neighbors. Corruption seeping into the World Tree drove them into frenzy and madness. Their mystics once practiced harmonious nature rites, but began drawing on distorted magical energies. Travelers can track down Ferocitas by cutting through the mystics guarding his woodland enclave. The jewel can then be returned to Tallonkai, so his dreamcatcher may be made whole and balance restored to the woods.

faq.q: Where do I find Ferocitas the Dream Eater?
faq.answer: Ferocitas the Dream Eater is in the forest north of Starbreeze Village on Teldrassil, among corrupted Gnarlpine mystics and other woodland hazards.
Ferocitas is a Gnarlpine furbolg leader who commands corrupted mystics north of Starbreeze Village. He took the emerald from Tallonkai Swiftroot's dreamcatcher and made it into a crude necklace.

faq.q: Why does Tallonkai Swiftroot want the jewel back?
faq.answer: The emerald is the core power source of Tallonkai's dreamcatcher. Without it, the talisman cannot be repaired or channel the Emerald Dream's protective energies.

faq.q: Can the Gnarlpine actually use the emerald's magic?
faq.answer: No. Tallonkai Swiftroot says the emerald's magic is useless to Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics, who coveted it only as a glowing bauble.
This is the final chapter of the two-part chain that began with The Emerald Dreamcatcher. Once you deliver the jewel to Tallonkai in Dolanaar, he can repair his heirloom.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine mystics hostile?
faq.answer: A strange corruption warping the boughs of the newly planted World Tree has affected much of Teldrassil's wildlife and furbolg tribes. It has twisted the Gnarlpine's minds and made them aggressive.

angles.text: As a night elf defending Teldrassil, you see a tragedy in the corruption of the Gnarlpine mystics and their theft of sacred talismans. The Gnarlpine were once allies of the Kaldorei.
As a druid, you know dreamcatchers are potent instruments tied to the Emerald Dream. A corrupted furbolg has defiled one, and nature calls for swift retribution.
